# Writing cottage asset generation

Mode: built-in image_gen. Exactly two calls: day generation, then night lighting edit.

## Day prompt

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: full-bleed background for a personal literary writing cottage website; one 3:2 landscape illustration, preferably 1536 × 1024 pixels.
Primary request: A cozy, peaceful literary writing cottage, an intimate room for reading personal essays and writing by hand. Newly composed scene, not a workshop.
Style/medium: clean crisp hand-drawn 2D cartoon animation background, thin dark ink contours, carefully drawn coherent perspective, attractive warm matte color fills, softly painted highlights, richly detailed yet calm. Match the visual character of the inspected reference only: friendly animation illustration, clear dark outlines, warm wood, lush green plants and a distant fantasy floating-island sky. Do not copy the reference composition.
Scene/backdrop: warm ivory plaster walls, teal and sage painted joinery, peach terracotta tile floor. A large ROUND window at the upper center/right reveals a leafy green tree, blue sky, soft clouds and small distant floating islands. A cushioned reading bench runs below this round window, with one black-and-white cow cat sleeping on it. Indoor houseplants.
Composition/framing: complete rectangular scene, 3:2 horizontal framing. A tall curved bookcase occupies the LEFT side, approximately x 15–29% and y 22–69% of the canvas. Antique walnut WRITING DESK in the foreground right center, approximately x 53–87% and y 55–80%; on its top, a prominent OPEN blank notebook centered near x 63%, y 66%, a fountain pen beside it, and a cream paper ENVELOPE with a small red wax seal near x 82%, y 64%. A small warm brass reading lamp stands on the desk. A simple wooden chair accompanies the desk. Leave the top-left ivory wall relatively quiet, especially x 3–30% and y 5–20%, for a future HTML heading; do not draw a heading or UI.
Lighting/mood: softly sunlit late afternoon, peaceful intimate literary atmosphere, sun patches on terracotta floor, warm light through the round window.
Constraints: no people. No computer, no printer, no globe, no screen, no technology. No lettering, no text, no labels, no titles, no book spine text, no writing on paper, no UI, no border, no watermark. The open notebook pages must be blank. Full opaque rectangular background, no transparency.

## Night prompt

Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: night-mode version of an existing literary writing cottage website background.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the finished day illustration. Make exactly one night lighting edit of this image, keeping its 1536 × 1024 dimensions and 3:2 landscape canvas.
Primary request: Transform ONLY time of day and illumination from late-afternoon sunlight to cozy deep-blue night. The round window shows a deep-blue nighttime sky, clouds, the same distant floating islands, tree and landscape, softly moonlit. The small brass desk reading lamp provides warm golden illumination over the blank open notebook, fountain pen, wax-sealed envelope and walnut desk, with a soft warm glow reaching the nearby bench and floor. The room remains clearly readable and intimate, with cooler blue ambient shadows.
Invariants: Preserve EXACT room architecture, camera angle, perspective, framing, all object geometry and positions, every plant and book position, round window, left bookcase, cushion positions, sleeping black-and-white cat pose, desk, chair, open notebook, pen, cream sealed envelope, brass lamp, terracotta tile pattern, wall decoration and floor rug. No resizing, no cropping, no camera shift, no newly added objects, no removed objects. Keep all original drawn edges and shapes aligned so day and night can crossfade in a website without objects jumping.
Style: maintain the same crisp hand-drawn 2D animation background illustration, dark thin ink contours, material detail and matte painted finish. Only palette, lighting and shadows change. Remove the strong daytime sun patches and replace them with soft night illumination.
Constraints: no people, no screens or technology, no text, no lettering, no labels, no UI, no border, no watermark. Notebook pages stay blank. Full opaque rectangular background, no transparency.
